paraphrase: Now, while the Buddha's dispensation lasts, is the rare opportunity to develop the thirty-seven requisites of awakening; one should not merely do meritorious deeds wishing to meet a future Buddha, but strive for the path in this life, beginning with firm virtue and mindfulness of the body.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
